findings.source_passage: not long after the German ship Jungfrau disappeared, took more than customary pains in that occupation; crawling under its bottom, where it hung over the side
findings.why_it_matters: The reference to the Jungfrau creates a narrative continuity thread with the preceding chapter and signals Queequeg's presentiment more precisely; its erasure flattens the episodic connective tissue and the emphasis on 'more than customary pains.'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'not long after the German ship Jungfrau disappeared, took more than customary pains in that occupation' before the crawling description.

findings.source_passage: Small sword, or broad sword, in all its exercises boasts nothing like it. It is only indispensable with an inveterate running whale
findings.why_it_matters: The sword-combat comparison is a characteristic Melvillean rhetorical flourish that elevates the whaleman's art above martial traditions; its omission reduces the passage's voice and interpretive claim about whaling as supreme skill.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert 'Small sword, or broad sword, in all its exercises boasts nothing like it' after 'none exceed that fine manœuvre with the lance called pitchpoling.'

findings.source_passage: But before going further, it is important to mention here, that though the harpoon may be pitchpoled in the same way with the lance, yet it is seldom done
findings.source_locator: paragraph 5 (entire paragraph on harpoon vs. lance)
findings.why_it_matters: This technical digression is characteristic of Melville's encyclopedic narrator voice; its absence is a mild compression loss but does not rise to high severity given the chapter's tone.
findings.suggested_fix: If word budget allows, restore the harpoon-comparison paragraph as a brief aside to maintain the narrator's encyclopedic register.

findings.source_passage: By great exertion, Tashtego at last succeeded in planting one iron
findings.why_it_matters: 'By great exertion… at last succeeded' carries narrative drama that 'Tashtego planted one iron' collapses; minor but flattens the action.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'By great exertion, Tashtego at last succeeded in planting one iron.'

summary: The draft preserves all high-priority signatures including the full pitchpoling action sequence, Stubb's speech, and the closing image; two medium-severity omissions (Jungfrau reference, sword-comparison flourish) and two low-severity flattenings are present but insufficient to trigger regeneration.
